annotations.title: Cheap text to speech: up to 2,000 characters in English as one MP3

description: Low-cost text to speech for longer English text: up to 2,000 characters as one MP3 (base64) with Deepgram Aura-1, 12 voices. Half the price per character of text_to_speech, with a slightly less natural voice. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for narration drafts, read-aloud of articles and summaries, notifications and accessibility at volume; for the most natural voices or Spanish use text_to_speech. Example: text=Your order has shipped and should reach you within three working days.. Price $0.04/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
